add.title: Add a disk
add.description: Pick a disk to add as a new data disk (doc 02 §4). No rebuild is needed — the pool includes it on the next mount.

replace.title: Replace a disk
replace.description: Pick the slot to replace and its replacement disk (doc 02 §4). SnapRAID reconstructs its contents from parity.
replace.wrongFilesystemNote: {{device}} carries a different filesystem than this slot's own record — it will be erased and rebuilt from parity. No other disk can take this slot.
replace.mountFailedNote: {{device}} is present but could not be mounted — this is usually a blank replacement disk. Replacing it here checks it is genuinely blank before rebuilding it from parity. No other disk can take this slot.

upgrade.title: Upgrade a disk
upgrade.description: Pick the data or parity disk to upgrade and its larger replacement. The old disk is copied and verified, and is never released until that check passes. A data disk is upgraded only while the array is stopped, and the array stays stopped until you start it again.
upgrade.confirmDescription: {{device}} will take over once it is copied and verified.
upgrade.newMountpointItem: New parity disk mounts at {{mountpoint}} until the switch

rebalanceDialog.title: Rebalance the pool
rebalanceDialog.description: Moves files between data disks to even out fill levels (doc 09 §3). Runs as a background job, not a rebuild.
rebalanceDialog.alreadyBalanced: The pool is already balanced — there is nothing to move.
rebalanceDialog.confirmDescription: Every moved file is copied, verified and synced before its old copy is deleted.

remove.title: Remove a disk
remove.description: Moves a data disk's files onto the pool's remaining disks — the first step of removing it (doc 09 §4). The disk is not ready to pull afterwards: it stays in the pool and in parity until you finish its removal with `hoserva disk remove finish`.
remove.confirmDescription: Every file is copied, verified and synced onto the pool's remaining disks before the originals are deleted.

badge.evacuating: Being emptied — no new files land here

removal.finishDescription: Takes {{mountpoint}} out of the pool and SnapRAID, then reports it safe to pull (doc 09 §4).
removal.cancelDescription: Returns {{mountpoint}} to normal use — it takes new files again immediately.

finishRemoval.title: Finish removing {{mountpoint}}
finishRemoval.description: Takes the disk out of every pool mount and out of SnapRAID, then unmounts it. Its filesystem is never wiped.
finishRemoval.confirmDescription: This runs immediately once you type the phrase below — there is no further confirmation.
finishRemoval.safeToRemove: {{mountpoint}} ({{identity}}) is safe to physically remove. Its filesystem was not wiped.
finishRemoval.safeToRemoveNoIdentity: {{mountpoint}} is safe to physically remove. Its filesystem was not wiped.

cancelRemoval.title: Cancel removing {{mountpoint}}?
cancelRemoval.description: The disk returns to normal use and starts taking new files again immediately.

ups.title: UPS
ups.emptyDescription: A UPS is optional. Configure one here if you have a USB-attached UPS or a network NUT server, so Hoserva can pause work on battery and shut down cleanly when power is almost gone.
ups.connectionHint: USB means Hoserva runs NUT locally against an attached UPS. Network means this host monitors a remote NUT server.
ups.connectionUsbDescription: A UPS plugged into this server. Hoserva generates the local NUT driver and monitor configuration.
ups.connectionNetworkDescription: Monitor a UPS already managed by another NUT server on your network.
ups.driverHint: The NUT driver name for your UPS model (for example usbhid-ups). Hoserva does not probe hardware compatibility.
ups.monitorPasswordHint: Password the local NUT monitor uses to talk to the local NUT server. Stored encrypted; never shown again.
ups.networkUpsNameHint: The UPS name configured on that NUT server.
ups.passwordKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current password
ups.lowBatteryPercentHint: When the UPS reports charge at or below this percent, Hoserva starts a clean shutdown. USB only — a network NUT server uses its own threshold.
ups.runtimeSecondsHint: When estimated runtime on battery falls to this many seconds, Hoserva starts a clean shutdown. USB only.

network.allowAllConfirmDescription: The UI will accept connections from any address, not just the LAN. Use this only if you understand the risk.
network.portDescription: TLS-only TCP port (default 8008). A change is used the next time Hoserva starts.
network.portRestart: Restart Hoserva to listen on the new port.

apply.title: Restore this configuration
apply.description: This replaces the settings on this server with the ones in the archive.
apply.itemReplace: Shares, users, schedules, destinations, app templates and app stacks are replaced by the archive's.
apply.itemSignedOut: You will be signed out when the restore finishes.
apply.itemSafetyArchive: A backup of the current configuration is written first, so you can go back.
apply.noReport: The server did not return a restore report. Check the destinations for the backup made before the restore.

report.signedOutTitle: The restore is finished and you were signed out
report.signedOutDescription: The archive's sign-in sessions replaced the current ones. Sign in again to continue.
report.nothingLeftOut: Everything in the archive was restored.
report.safetyArchive: The configuration as it was before is saved as {{archive}}.
report.noSafetyArchive: No backup destination was written to before the restore.

preImportSecrets.request: That backup's secrets are sealed with the passphrase you entered.
preImportSecrets.configured: That backup's secrets are sealed with this server's backup passphrase.

appdata.title: Appdata backup
appdata.description: Backs up each app's own files (its appdata folder) so an app can be put back the way it was. Choose which apps are included and whether each is stopped while its files are copied. The schedule is on the Schedules page.
appdata.backupFailed: Could not start the appdata backup

errors.array_stopped: The array is stopped, so appdata cannot be backed up or restored
errors.container_not_found: That app has no appdata in the backup
errors.archive_not_found: That archive is no longer on the destination
errors.backup_destination_not_found: That backup destination no longer exists
errors.appdata_archive_invalid: That is not an appdata archive of this server and app
errors.appdata_preview_gone: The preview is no longer available
errors.appdata_preview_not_ready: The preview is not ready yet
errors.not_configured: This server cannot back up appdata

policy.loadFailed: Could not load the appdata backup settings
policy.saveFailed: Could not save the backup setting for {{name}}
policy.noEngineTitle: Apps are not available on this server
policy.noEngineDescription: This server has no Docker Engine connection, so there are no apps whose appdata could be backed up.
policy.engineUnreachableTitle: The Docker Engine is not reachable
policy.engineUnreachableDescription: Hoserva could not reach the Docker Engine, so it cannot list the apps to back up.

empty.title: No apps with appdata
empty.description: No container keeps files in the appdata folder yet. Apps you install will appear here.

policy.stopFor: Stop {{name}} while its appdata is copied
policy.hint: Copying a database's files while it runs can give a backup that does not restore, so databases are best stopped while they are copied. An app that is stopped is started again afterwards.

archives.title: Appdata archives and restore
archives.description: The appdata backups found on your destinations, newest first. Restore puts one app's files back from an archive, after showing what it would replace.
archives.loadFailed: Could not load the appdata archives

empty.title: No appdata archives yet
empty.description: No appdata backup has been written to a destination yet. Use Back up now, or wait for the schedule.
empty.descriptionPartial: None were found on the destinations that could be listed.

restore.title: Restore {{container}}
restore.noChanges: The archive and the current files are identical, so nothing would change.
restore.itemReplace: Each folder in the archive is replaced as a whole: files that are not in the archive are removed.
restore.itemSnapshot: A snapshot of the current appdata is written to your destinations first. If that fails, nothing is changed.
restore.itemStop: The app is stopped during the restore and started again afterwards.

drill.title: Restore drill
drill.description: Checks that your newest backup on each destination can really be restored. It fetches the archive, opens it the way a restore would and verifies it, then throws everything away. Nothing is written to a destination.
drill.loadFailed: Could not load the last restore drill
drill.neverRunDescription: No restore drill has run yet. It runs on its schedule, or you can run one now.
drill.noDestinationsTested: The drill could not test any destination
drill.notScheduled: Not scheduled. The restore drill schedule is off.
drill.runFailed: Could not start the restore drill
drill.queuedDescription: The result appears here when the job finishes. Job status: {{status}}.

updates.apiNote: Security updates install unattended. Hoserva never reboots on its own — reboot is always your action (Q68).
updates.updateCheckDescription: Read the signed release index for the selected channel (Q67).
updates.dependenciesEmpty: Installed mergerfs and SnapRAID versions are not reported yet.
updates.systemDescription: Security updates install unattended (Q68). Reboot is always your action.
updates.pendingDebianEmpty: No pending Debian security updates in the apt cache.

update.title: Update Hoserva?
update.description: Hoserva downloads the release package, verifies checksums, runs a config backup and installs in a transient unit. The update is refused while parity, array-write or topology jobs run.

rollback.title: Rollback Hoserva?
rollback.description: Rollback installs the previous release package and restores its pre-migration database snapshot (Q67).

reboot.title: Reboot the server?
reboot.description: Reboot waits for parity, array-write and topology jobs, then runs the clean shutdown sequence (Q68, Q70).

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to manage this Hoserva server.

fields.totpHint: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.

errors.totpRequired: This account uses an authenticator — enter the current code.
errors.totpInvalid: That authenticator code is not valid. Try again.

cache-then-move.label: Cache then move
cache-then-move.description: New files land on cache and move to the array later. Protected by parity once moved.

cache-only.label: Cache only
cache-only.description: Files stay on cache and never touch the array — not covered by parity (doc 02 §1).

array-only.label: Array only
array-only.description: Files write straight to the array and are covered by parity from the next sync.

list.description: Every configured share, with cache mode, SMB and NFS status.

empty.title: No shares yet
empty.description: A share is a named folder in the pool with its own cache mode, SMB and NFS settings. Create one to start storing files.

list.deleteDescription: This removes the share definition. Files already written to this share are not deleted.
list.deleteConfirmDescription: The share's files stay on disk. Deleting data is a separate action on the share's danger zone.

create.description: New shares use the default cache mode and create policy. Adjust them from the share's detail page.
create.name: Share name

errors.maintenanceMode: The array is stopped. Start the array before creating, updating or deleting a share — otherwise directories would be written under the disk mounts on the root filesystem and hidden when the array starts again.

general.title: General
general.name: Name: {{name}}
general.notYetSyncedDescription: This share hasn't been through a parity sync since it was created, so size and per-disk distribution aren't available yet.
general.perDiskEmpty: This share has no files on any disk yet.

mspmfs.label: Keep folders together
mspmfs.description: Prefers a disk that already holds this directory; if none has room, retries with the parent directory, then its parent.

mfs.label: Balance across disks
mfs.description: New file goes to the disk with the most free space.

lfs.label: Quiet disks
lfs.description: Least free space that still fits — fills one disk at a time, maximises spindown.

ff.label: Fill disks in order
ff.description: First disk with room, in branch order.

cache.title: Cache mode
cache.confirmDescription: This changes where new files are placed. Existing files stay where they are unless you choose to relocate them.

browse.wakeWarningDescription: Listing this share's files reads directly from the disks that hold them. This is an explicit action — nothing on this page runs automatically.
browse.deleteConfirmDescription: This permanently deletes "{{path}}" from the share. This cannot be undone.

danger.removeDescription: Removes the share definition and stops SMB/NFS for it. The share's files stay on disk.
danger.removeConfirmDescription: The share's files are not deleted. This only removes the share definition and its SMB/NFS configuration.
danger.deleteDataDescription: Permanently deletes every file this share holds on every disk it uses. The share definition is left in place.
danger.deleteDataConfirmTitle: This will permanently delete this share's files
danger.deleteDataConfirmDescription: Every file this share holds is deleted from every disk it uses. This cannot be undone. Type the share name to confirm.

users.description: Accounts, groups, sessions and API tokens for this Hoserva server.

empty.title: No accounts yet
empty.description: Create an account to give someone UI access, SMB/NFS access, or both.

errors.permissionsLoadFailed: Could not load this account's share permissions

panel.adminRoleLocked: The sole admin account's role cannot be changed here.

roleDescriptions.viewer: Read-only UI access. UI login: yes.
roleDescriptions.share-only: SMB/NFS access only, no UI login. This is the default for new accounts.

panel.uiLoginAccessDescription: Whether this account can currently sign in to this UI — a viewer or admin role with a credential provisioned.
panel.smbAccessDescription: Setting a password provisions the Samba account together with the UI credential (Q27). A user account can carry both UI login and SMB access.
panel.smbAccessSetActionDescription: Provisions or updates the Samba account. This does not remove existing SMB access, and leaving it unchecked does not change it either.

groups.title: Groups
groups.empty: No groups yet. Groups are a named collection of accounts for bulk share-permission assignment.
groups.name: Group name

tokens.title: Personal API tokens
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.createdDescription: This value is shown once. Copy it now — Hoserva only stores its hash from here on.

oidc.title: Single sign-on (OIDC)
oidc.description: OIDC configuration is on the roadmap and not available yet.
